summary: Sila Realty Trust (SILA) filed an 8-K disclosing shareholder lawsuits and demand letters challenging its proposed merger with Sunshine Ultimate Parent LLC, a going-private transaction. The merger agreement was signed April 19, 2026; Sila will merge into Merger Sub and be wholly owned by Parent. A special meeting is set for June 26, 2026, to vote on the deal. Two individual complaints and 15 demand letters allege deficient disclosures in the proxy statements, seeking to enjoin the merger or obtain damages. The board denies the allegations. The risk-arb angle is that litigation could delay or increase deal consideration, though the company views the suits as meritless.
